parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — no lemon in the first six checks
$P(\text{no lemon in the first six checks})=\left(\frac45\right)^6$. [M1]
Guidance: Use the probability of no lemon in the first six checks; follow through a correct stated lemon probability and accept an equivalent complement expansion.
$\left(\frac45\right)^6=\frac{4096}{15625}=0.262$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.262144$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Method 2 — complement
$1-P(\text{at least one lemon in the first six checks})=1-\sum_{x=1}^{6}\binom6x\left(\frac15\right)^x\left(\frac45\right)^{6-x}$. [M1]
Guidance: Use the complement of one or more lemons among the first six checks; omission of the final six-lemon term is condoned.
$=\frac{4096}{15625}=0.262$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.262144$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Total: 2

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — all three non-orange
$\frac{10}{15}\times\frac9{14}\times\frac8{13}$. [M1]
Guidance: Use three successive non-orange probabilities with decreasing numerators and denominators and no additional terms.
$\frac{10}{15}\times\frac9{14}\times\frac8{13}=\frac{24}{91}=0.264$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.263736$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Method 2 — enumerate lemon counts
$\frac3{15}\frac2{14}\frac1{13}+3\frac3{15}\frac2{14}\frac7{13}+3\frac3{15}\frac7{14}\frac6{13}+\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac5{13}$. [M1]
Guidance: Enumerate the four lemon/strawberry compositions; condone one numerator error or a complete tree with all scenarios and an attempted evaluation.
$\frac{24}{91}=0.264$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.263736$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Method 3 — complement
$1-\left(\frac5{15}\frac4{14}\frac3{13}+3\frac5{15}\frac4{14}\frac{10}{13}+3\frac5{15}\frac{10}{14}\frac9{13}\right)$. [M1]
Guidance: Subtract the probabilities of one, two or three oranges from 1; condone one numerator error.
$\frac{24}{91}=0.264$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.263736$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Method 4 — combinations
$\frac{\binom{10}{3}}{\binom{15}{3}}$. [M1]
Guidance: Use the ratio $\binom{10}{3}/\binom{15}{3}$.
$\frac{\binom{10}{3}}{\binom{15}{3}}=\frac{24}{91}=0.264$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.263736$ rounded to more than three significant figures.
Total: 2

parts.label: (d)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — ordered draws
$\frac7{15}\times\frac5{14}\times\frac3{13}$. [M1]
Guidance: Use one probability factor for each of the three flavours with denominators 13, 14 and 15 in some order.
$3!\times\frac7{15}\times\frac5{14}\times\frac3{13}$. [M1]
Guidance: Account for all $3!$ orders, or add six identical ordered probabilities, with no additional cases.
$3!\times\frac7{15}\times\frac5{14}\times\frac3{13}=\frac3{13}=0.231$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.230769$ rounded, not truncated, beyond three significant figures.
Method 2 — combinations
$\binom71\binom51\binom31$. [M1]
Guidance: Choose one from each flavour; use of permutations is condoned for the first method mark.
$\frac{\binom71\binom51\binom31}{\binom{15}{3}}$. [M1]
Guidance: Divide the favourable selections by $\binom{15}{3}$ (or an equivalent permutation denominator).
$\frac{\binom71\binom51\binom31}{\binom{15}{3}}=\frac3{13}=0.231$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $0.230769$ rounded, not truncated, beyond three significant figures.
Total: 3

Method 1 — ordered probabilities
$3\left(\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac3{13}\right)$ for the three arrangements with two strawberries and one lemon. [B1]

$\dfrac{\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac5{13}+3\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac3{13}}{24/91}$. [M1]
Guidance: Divide the favourable probability by the part-(c) probability of no orange, including a consistent follow-through denominator.
$\dfrac{\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac5{13}+3\frac7{15}\frac6{14}\frac3{13}}{24/91}=\frac{49}{60}=0.817$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept $49/60$ or a decimal rounding to $0.817$.

$\binom73$ for three strawberries. [B1]

$\frac{\binom72\binom31+\binom73}{\binom{10}{3}}$. [M1]
Guidance: Divide by $\binom{10}{3}$ or a denominator consistent with the no-orange sample space.

Guidance: Accept $49/60$ or a decimal rounding to $0.817$.
